column1: # ZAP Baseline Scan — alert threshold overrides
# 10015  Incomplete or No Cache-control Header — acceptable for SPA assets
# 10027  Information Disclosure — Suspicious Comments (dev comments in source)
# 10096  Timestamp Disclosure — Unix timestamps in API responses are intentional
# 90005  Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing — browser-only header, not sent by ZAP
# 10020  X-Frame-Options Header — helmet sets this; warn if missing
# 10021  X-Content-Type-Options Header — helmet sets this; warn if missing
# 10035  Strict-Transport-Security Header — only relevant in production with TLS
# 10038  Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set — helmet sets this; warn
